description: CLUES is Mexico's official catalogue of health establishments, giving every hospital, clinic, laboratory and mobile health unit a unique key used across all health information systems. It is maintained by the General Directorate of Health Information (DGIS) of the Ministry of Health under the national health information standard NOM-024-SSA3-2012. The monthly file lists about 64,000 establishments of all public and private institutions with their institution, state, municipality, locality and health jurisdiction, establishment type, typology and level of care, full address, operating status, construction date and start of operation, ownership of the building, mobile unit details, latitude and longitude, and the reason and date of closure for units that have closed. Further sheets give sub-units and opening hours. The file is free and available to download as Excel from the DGIS catalogue page, which states that its variables are open to the whole health sector without restrictions on use. Caveats: bed counts and staffing are not in the catalogue, coordinates should be checked before use, and the file is large (25 MB). Simulation uses: mapping health facilities against earthquake, hurricane and flood hazards, using construction dates as a proxy for building vulnerability, and modelling access to each level of care. Related records: the Brazilian CNES register (data-cnes-brazil-health-establishments-api) and the Spanish hospital catalogue (data-spain-catalogo-nacional-hospitales) are comparable registers.
